item.title: Senate approves sweeping bill to regulate college sports
item.description: The Senate on Thursday approved a sweeping college sports bill to establish a federal framework for college athletics aimed at protecting student athletes — despite some pushback from some Democrats who argue that it could do the opposite.

item.title: OpenAI halts model release over safety concerns: "Didn't quite meet the bar"
item.description: OpenAI said it has chosen not to release its new GPT-6.1 Astra model due to concerns about safety, as industry leaders warn of the risks posed by ever-more-powerful AI technology.

item.title: Former "American Idol" singer's murder trial moves to closing arguments
item.description: A former Ohio music pastor who appeared on the singing competition "American Idol" is on trial over allegations that he killed his wife while having an affair.

item.title: Man who spent decades on death row ordered released on bail after no DNA match
item.description: No physical evidence linked him to the crime scene, but the jury convicted Douglas Stewart Carter, a Black man, based on a confession and two witnesses who later recanted.

item.title: Details emerge in case of former Cornell student alleging rape by frat members
item.description: A woman, identified only as Jane Doe, alleges she was gang-raped by seven fraternity members in 2024 and accuses Cornell University of failing to protect her.

item.title: Cornell fraternity rape case will reopen after a woman alleges she was assaulted by 7 men in 2024
item.description: Nearly two years after a young woman first told authorities that she'd been raped inside a fraternity house at Cornell University, the local district attorney, who had initially declined to pursue criminal charges, says he is reopening the investigation. Lilia Luciano reports on what's changed.

item.title: Trump, Johnson to meet with AI execs at White House amid debate over safety
item.description: The meeting comes as some industry leaders warn about the risks of rapid AI advancements.

item.title: Trump announces multi-billion dollar steel plant project in Iowa
item.description: President Trump has announced a multi-billion-dollar steel plant project in Iowa. What the president called the "largest steel plant in U.S. history" is expected to be up and running by 2030. CBS News correspondent Lana Zak has more details.

item.title: MLB playoffs to begin with Wild Card round that includes Yankees-Red Sox matchup
item.description: Major League Baseball's grueling 162-game regular season ended on Sunday and postseason baseball is here. Four games kick off the wild-card round starting Tuesday. Levi Weaver, a staff writer for The Athletic, previews the MLB playoffs.

item.title: Russian drone hits cultural landmark in Ukraine's capital
item.description: Russia struck a cultural landmark in Ukraine on Monday, the National Academy of Sciences, killing at least seven people and wounding dozens more. They also attacked apartment buildings, offices and data centers. CBS News international reporter Aidan Stretch was forced to take shelter shortly after creating this report. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean also has more on the war.

item.title: Nvidia announces new software to prevent AI agents from "going rogue"
item.description: Technology company and chip maker Nvidia has created a new security platform aimed at preventing artificial intelligence agents from going rogue. Connor Leahy, executive director of ControlAI, joins "The Daily Report" to discuss.

item.title: Details on Nvidia's new security platform designed to stop rogue AI
item.description: Nvidia has unveiled a new security platform that it hopes will stop AI agents from going rogue. Stephen Nellis, technology correspondent at Reuters, joins CBS News to discuss.

item.title: Fetterman says it's "entirely possible" for Democrats to take back Senate in midterms
item.description: The 2026 midterm elections are a little over a month away and Democrats are hoping to win back both chambers of Congress. CBS News' Taurean Small reports.

item.title: Cleanup underway after powerful nor'easter batters East Coast
item.description: Recovery efforts are underway in parts of the northeaster after a nor'easter brought destructive winds and heavy rain over the weekend. CBS News' Rob Marciano has more.

item.title: What to know as criminal probe reopened into alleged 2024 Cornell gang rape
item.description: Prosecutors say they are reopening an investigation into an alleged 2024 gang rape at Cornell University. CBS News' Anna Schecter reports.

item.title: High inflation, gas prices push Trump approval ratings down: "The polls are fake," he says
item.description: High inflation and high gas prices due to the war with Iran have pushed President Trump's approval ratings on the economy to near-record lows, which is causing headwinds for Republican candidates running this November. Nancy Cordes reports.

item.title: Hurricane Polo threatens Southwest U.S. with flooding. See its path.
item.description: Hurricane Polo could bring "life-threatening winds and flash floods" to Mexico's Baja California Sur and nearby Sonora and then heavy rain and flooding to parts of the U.S.

item.title: U.S. and Iran hold indirect talks with midterms 36 days away
item.description: President Trump has rejected Iran's proposal to end the war, but both sides are still holding indirect talks. CBS News' Aaron Navarro reports.

item.title: FAA delays Boeing 737 MAX 10 approval due to software glitch
item.description: The FAA warned airlines that it will delay approving the 737 MAX 10, the largest version of the 737. Boeing said a software glitch could cause a flight control system to shut off unexpectedly. Kris Van Cleave reports.

item.title: GOP Sen. John Kennedy slams Trump's taxpayer-funded ad
item.description: A new, taxpayer-funded ad campaign glorifying President Trump is facing bipartisan backlash. Former RNC communications director Doug Heye and Democratic strategist Hyma Moore join "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: New video of text chain from night of alleged Cornell gang rape
item.description: CBS News New York has exclusively obtained additional video of the fraternity's group Snapchat conversation from the night a former Cornell student says she was drugged and raped inside the Chi Phi fraternity house.

item.title: Justin Verlander is now a former MLB player, but forever a dad
item.description: Justin Verlander started his final Major League Baseball game on Saturday, and when the 43-year-old came off the mound, he was surprised by his 7-year-old daughter Genevive. Tony Dokoupil has the story.

item.title: New giant pandas from China arrive in Atlanta zoo
item.description: Zoo Atlanta said giant pandas Ping Ping and Fu Shuang arrived at Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport on Sunday morning.

item.title: Russia hammers Ukraine's capital with major daytime drone strike
item.description: A wave of Russian strikes hit Ukraine Monday, killing at least 7 people, including a woman hit by a daytime strike on the National Academy of Sciences in Kyiv.

item.title: Giant pandas settle into Zoo Atlanta home after journey from China
item.description: After a 16-hour flight from China on a custom plane and a police escort from the airport to an Atlanta zoo, America's newest giant pandas are in their new home and are getting ready to meet the public. Skyler Henry is there.

item.title: 5 men arrested near U.K. air base used by U.S. released on bail
item.description: Police say five U.K. nationals who were arrested near RAF Fairford air base in England, which is used by U.S. forces, have been released on bail.

item.title: Russia strikes Ukraine's National Academy of Sciences, full of workers
item.description: Russian drones slammed into Ukraine's capital of Kyiv on Monday, one torching the National Academy of Sciences building. Aiden Stretch reports.

item.title: SpaceX launches Starship on giant rocket's first flight to orbit
item.description: The Super Heavy-Starship rocket's 14th test flight, the first boosting the upper stage to orbit, marked a major milestone for both SpaceX and NASA.

item.title: Nor'easter winding down after hitting parts of East Coast hard
item.description: The storm brought heavy rain, flooding and destructive winds to the Northeast.

item.title: 9/28: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: Trump to meet with AI leaders about safety; more GOP candidates bucking Trump, calling for end to Iran war.
